gitFiles.error.badPath.text: submodule {name}'s path {path} isn't a folder inside this one
gitFiles.error.badPath.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): .gitmodules gives a submodule a path that is empty, absolute or goes outside the folder. {name} is its name, {path} the path.

gitFiles.error.clearStray.text: submodule {name}: the files left in {path} couldn't be removed: {error}
gitFiles.error.clearStray.note: A copy's setup error (HI-3080): a submodule's folder held only files an earlier run left (ignored build output, say), and Combwork couldn't remove them before setting the submodule up. {name} is the submodule's name, {path} its folder, {error} the system's words.

gitFiles.error.doubtfulLeft.text: the folder of removed submodule {path} isn't plainly this copy's own clone (a link, or another repository), so it was left as it is: move it away
gitFiles.error.doubtfulLeft.note: A copy's setup error (HI-1182): a submodule its revision no longer has left a folder that Combwork can't be sure it cloned itself, so it removes nothing and the copy isn't handed over. {path} is the folder.

gitFiles.error.foreign.text: submodule {name}: {path} holds files or a repository Combwork didn't set up. Move it away, or turn off Set up submodules and LFS
gitFiles.error.foreign.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): a submodule's folder already holds something that isn't this folder's own submodule clone, so Combwork changes nothing. {name} is the submodule's name, {path} its folder. Set up submodules and LFS is a setting's name: keep it as Combwork shows it.

gitFiles.error.lfs.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): `git lfs pull` failed. {error} is git-lfs's first line, else failed.

gitFiles.error.nested.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): initialising the submodules inside submodule {name} failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

gitFiles.error.noLfs.text: Git LFS is used, but git-lfs isn't installed
gitFiles.error.noLfs.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): the repository has files in Git LFS and git-lfs couldn't be run. Git LFS and git-lfs are names, as they are.

gitFiles.error.noLfsFilter.text: Git LFS is used, but it isn't set up for this repository: run git lfs install
gitFiles.error.noLfsFilter.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): git-lfs is installed but no LFS filter is configured (git lfs install was never run), so git lfs pull would leave pointer files. Git LFS and git lfs install are a name and a command, as they are.

gitFiles.error.noUrl.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): a submodule .gitmodules names has no url. {name} is its name.

gitFiles.error.removeLeft.text: the folder of removed submodule {path} couldn't be removed: {error}
gitFiles.error.removeLeft.note: A copy's setup error (HI-1182): a submodule the revision no longer has left its folder, and Combwork couldn't remove it. {path} is the folder, {error} git's first line or why.

gitFiles.error.stopped.text: the setup of submodules and Git LFS was ended
gitFiles.error.stopped.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): the run was ended (its time limit, or the workspace closing) before it finished.

gitFiles.error.unread.text: Combwork couldn't tell whether submodules or Git LFS are used: {error}
gitFiles.error.unread.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): git's read of .gitmodules or the LFS attributes failed. {error} is git's first line.

gitFiles.error.update.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): `git submodule update` failed. {error} is git's first line, else failed.

gitFiles.error.url.text: Combwork can't resolve submodule {name}'s URL {url}: set submodule.{name}.url
gitFiles.error.url.note: A slot's or copy's setup error (HI-1182): a relative submodule URL Combwork can't resolve as git would. {name} is the submodule's name, {url} the URL; submodule.{name}.url is a git config key, as it is.

gitFiles.remove.changed.text: the worktree has changes or untracked files, inside its submodules too: {path}
gitFiles.remove.changed.note: Why a slot with submodules wasn't removed (HI-3026): git's own clean check (its submodules counted) lists something. {path} is the first entry git lists.

gitFiles.remove.odd.text: couldn't check submodule {path} before removing the worktree: it isn't a clone Combwork can read (a link, a stray file, an incomplete clone, or nested too deep)
gitFiles.remove.odd.note: Why a slot with submodules wasn't removed (HI-3026): something under the worktree's git dir where submodule clones are kept isn't one Combwork can check, so nothing was removed. {path} is that folder under the worktree's git dir (.git: the worktree names no git dir).

gitFiles.remove.unpushed.text: submodule {path} has commits that aren't on its remote (a branch, tag or stash there, or a commit fetched by its id), which removing the worktree would delete
gitFiles.remove.unpushed.note: Why a slot with submodules wasn't removed (HI-3026): a submodule clone only this worktree has holds commits no remote-tracking ref has. {path} is the clone's folder under the worktree's git dir.

gitFiles.remove.unread.text: couldn't check submodule {path} before removing the worktree: {error}
gitFiles.remove.unread.note: Why a slot with submodules wasn't removed (HI-3026): a read of its submodules' clones failed, so nothing was removed. {path} is the clone's folder under the worktree's git dir, {error} git's first line or why.
